invariants.rationale: File name should not be null to identify the TMX file.
The FileHandle referencing the TMX file must not be null, as it is used for parsing.

invariants.expression: parameter == null || parameter.generateMipMaps == true || parameter.generateMipMaps == false
invariants.rationale: If parameter is not null, it must have an accessible boolean generateMipMaps field.
If parameter is not null, its textureMinFilter should be accessible and non-null.
If parameter is not null, its textureMagFilter should be accessible and non-null.
